WITH ZZ AS ( SELECT #{writeType} AS WRITE_TYPE , TO_DATE(#{startDate} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS START_DATE , TO_DATE(#{endDate} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1 AS END_DATE FROM DUAL ) SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.AgesStatsMapper : 연령별통계 LIST */ FF.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , MAX(FF.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM) AS GUBUN , MAX(FF.SRTNG_SQNCE) AS SRTNG_SQNCE , SUM(DECODE(CC.NTABRD_CSC_OCCP_SE_CD, 'S', CC.CCNT, 0) ) AS W01 /* 학생 */ , SUM(DECODE(CC.NTABRD_CSC_OCCP_SE_CD, 'T', CC.CCNT, 0) ) AS W02 /* 학업중단 */ , SUM(DECODE(CC.NTABRD_CSC_OCCP_SE_CD, 'A', CC.CCNT, 0) ) AS W03 /* 무직 */ , SUM(DECODE(CC.NTABRD_CSC_OCCP_SE_CD, 'B', CC.CCNT, 0) ) AS W04 /* 근로 */ , SUM(DECODE(CC.NTABRD_CSC_OCCP_SE_CD, 'N', CC.CCNT, 0) ) AS W05 /* 미취학 청소년 */ , SUM(DECODE(CC.NTABRD_CSC_OCCP_SE_CD, 'C', CC.CCNT, 0) ) AS W06 /* 학부모 */ , SUM(DECODE(CC.NTABRD_CSC_OCCP_SE_CD, 'D', CC.CCNT, 0) ) AS W07 /* 지도자 */ , SUM(DECODE(CC.NTABRD_CSC_OCCP_SE_CD, 'E', CC.CCNT, 0) ) AS W08 /* 일반인 */ , SUM(DECODE(CC.NTABRD_CSC_OCCP_SE_CD, 'F', CC.CCNT, 0) ) AS W09 /* 기타 */ , SUM(NVL(CC.CCNT, 0)) AS SSUM FROM ( SELECT AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , AA.NTABRD_CSC_OCCP_SE_CD , COUNT(*) AS CCNT FROM
AYE100 AA /* 사이버상담게시글 */
AYE120 AA /* 사이버상담답글 */
, ZZ WHERE 1=1
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= ZZ.START_DATE AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < ZZ.END_DATE
AND AA.NTABRD_CSC_OCCP_SE_CD IS NOT NULL GROUP BY AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , AA.NTABRD_CSC_OCCP_SE_CD ) CC , ( SELECT AA.* FROM SAC100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'MM_DSCSN_STATS_TYPE_SE_CD' /* 월상담통계유형구분코드 */ ) FF WHERE 1=1 AND CC.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD(+) = FF.CMMNS_CD_VALUE GROUP BY FF.CMMNS_CD_VALUE ORDER BY 3
